description: Elicitation: cua-approve.sh accepts every elicitation cua_repl sends (app and site approvals), so none shows a dialog. mods (function hooks, under CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1): /secret KEY, a secret typed into a pane's field, masked, stored in a 600 file under ~/.config/claude-secrets (in the session's project folder there; /secret -g KEY for every project) that the model sees only by its key; and devcloud's secrets guard (vendored, hooks/mods/guard): stored values, credential-file values and token-shaped strings are replaced by handles in every tool result, transcript row, attachment and system-prompt section the model reads, never refusing a call, and handles in Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and Bash input are restored to their exact bytes before the call runs; it stands down while devcloud's own plugin is loaded
